title: GSE cyclic-ordered unimodal slot transport replacement readiness
purpose: Replace the invalid scalar-degree rotation authority in V1 with distribution-space circular equivariance while preserving the failed V1 evidence, tolerance, population and all isolation rules.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 zero-training replacement readiness; no training, checkpoint, threshold, C09/C10/M-TARE, graph or planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User explicitly delegated autonomous best-option selection and requested no repeated approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 deduplicated five-frame causal LiDAR shards.
Sealed COUST V1 readiness failure and its exact metrics.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective targets.

worlds.fit: No fit. Audit all C01-C08 metadata and load eight deterministic real rows.
worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Re-audit every Teacher-source join and use the same eight deterministic real rows; no performance sampling.

teacher.source: Sealed 180-bin continuous exit bearing/width/profile plus local axis and global geometry.
teacher.use: Targets sorted by sensor azimuth and matched only through orientation-preserving cyclic shifts; no identity enters model or loss.
teacher.valid_mask: Existing exact peak, independent width and global geometry masks unchanged.
teacher.student_input: Five causal normalized range/valid images only for eight real rows.

split.historical_pollution_audit: V1 evidence is used only to correct a dimensionally invalid metric; no checkpoint is loaded.

methods.main: Same 788618-parameter COUST architecture and same frozen readiness computations as V1.
methods.baseline: V1: slot-mass rotation error 2.67e-7 passed, while an atan2 diagnostic of 0.003601 degrees was incorrectly pooled with dimensionless tensor errors.
methods.fallback: If distribution-space rotation, order, unimodality, gradient, causal or real-backward checks fail, stop COUST before training.

acceptance.population: Exact 80 worlds, 188126 observations, 396913 peaks and fixed cardinality counts.
acceptance.order: Cyclic shift invariant; reversed K=3 assignment strictly worse.
acceptance.unimodality: Mass normalized and finite; sharp slot has one local maximum and concentration above 0.999.
acceptance.gradient: Duplicate K=3 slots receive negative missing-target gradient.
acceptance.symmetry: Projected/raw circular distribution, concentration, geometry, cyclic-slot and batch errors at most 3e-5; repeat exactly zero. Bearing-in-degrees remains diagnostic and is not pooled with dimensionless tensor errors.
acceptance.real_batch: Finite forward, loss and backward on eight real rows containing one through four exits.

failure_policy: Fail closed. Preserve V1 as failed evidence. Do not change the 3e-5 distribution tolerance, population, model, data or isolation. PASS authorizes only a training Data Card.
retention: Retain V1 and V1r summaries, selected rows, figures/source, environment, log, RUN_STATE and seals.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU full metadata audit plus eight-row forward/backward
